text:
Riley (People Ops): Quick update for NYC folks: due to an unexpected water main repair, the usual venue for next week's Onsite (Jun 22) has been changed. New location: 207 Hudson St, Suite 400. Shuttle + logistics below. :triangular_flag_on_post:

Jordan (Events): New venue has onsite secure bike parking and a larger ballroom for meals. All sessions times stay the same.

Priya (Office Ops): Shuttle run from Penn Station -> venue: 8:00, 8:30, 9:00 (morning) and 17:30, 18:00, 18:30 (evening). Shuttles are first-come, priority for folks with >5 mile commute.

Alex (Eng): I need to bring a 4U server for a demo. Is there loading dock access?

Priya (Office Ops): Yes  loading dock available 7:30-9:30am. Email ops-logistics@redwood.ai with dimensions by EOD Friday so we can reserve a dolly and secure storage.

Marisol (Recruiting): Interview rooms: we've moved all onsite interviews to Partner Room B on the 3rd floor. Candidates will be notified; interviewers continue to check Greenhouse for updates.

Riley (People Ops): Travel/expense notes:
- If you already booked a hotel near the old venue and need to change, submit a change fee receipt; we'll reimburse up to $75 for rebooking.
- Local transit stipend extended to commuters who now travel >3 miles (one-time $10).
- If you need overnight stay due to schedule changes, pre-approve with people-ops@redwood.ai.

SupportBot: Shuttle schedule posted: REF-ON-2026-332. Reminder: RSVP updated on the event page.

Alex (Eng): Will there be secure storage for demo racks overnight?

Priya (Office Ops): Secure room available; label equipment and lockable containers required. We'll provide a chain-of-custody form at check-in.

Marisol (Recruiting): Candidate meals? If we feed onsite candidates, any dietary restrictions guidance?

Jordan (Events): Catering will have vegan, GF, nut-free options. If candidate needs special accommodations, flag in Greenhouse note and People Ops will handle.

Riley (People Ops): Badge logistics: temporary badges will be issued at the welcome desk. If you lost your badge, bring ID; we'll issue a same-day visitor badge. Do not tailgate in the elevator.

Alex (Eng): Any changes to the code of conduct or recording policy? I'm recording my talk for the team.

Riley (People Ops): Recording allowed with speaker consent. Still follow Redwood recording policy: announce at session start and upload files to the internal drive. Code of conduct unchanged  respectful behavior expected.

Priya (Office Ops): Expense snippet for rebooking fee (paste into the expense form):
```
Expense: Flight change fee
Amount: $62.00 USD
Date: 2026-06-16
Category: Travel - Venue change reimbursement
Notes: Rebooking due to venue change (207 Hudson)
```

Marisol (Recruiting): If any interviewer can't make the new location, we will auto-switch to virtual panel. Please update your availability in Greenhouse by EOD Monday.

SupportBot: Push notification sent to all registered attendees. Ref: NOTIF-7742.

Riley (People Ops): Thanks everyone  we'll post maps, shuttle pickup markers, and a short FAQ in the event thread in ~30min. DM People Ops for special needs. :sparkles:
